jobs.description:
You will work both:

• in hotels (mobile service), and
• at our practice/clinic in Lech 
Your profile

• Completed training as a Licensed Massage Therapist or Massage Therapist
• Previous professional experience is an advantage
• Basic knowledge of computer skills (IT) and English
• We are looking for motivated and reliable team members with a friendly, customer-oriented attitude 
Pay

The minimum salary for the position of Licensed Massage Therapist or Massage Therapist is EUR 20.00 gross per hour.

Willingness to pay above the minimum rate depending on qualifications and experience.

What we offer

• A pleasant working environment
• Flexible working hours with full-time or part-time options (free time in the mornings, work scheduled in the afternoons)
• Discounted ski pass valid throughout the entire Arlberg region
• Competitive salary above the collective agreement rate
• Additional pay for Sundays and public holidays
• Free accommodation provided by the employer

Your main area of work will be sports traumatology.
  
Your profile

• Completed training/degree as a Physiotherapist
• Professional experience is desirable
• Recent graduates are also welcome, provided they are passionate about their profession
• Knowledge of osteopathy and/or manual therapy is considered an advantage
• 
Good computer skills and English language skills are required

We are seeking motivated, reliable team members with a friendly and customer-oriented attitude. You will provide outpatient treatments both in local hotels and at our practice.
 
Pay

The minimum salary for the position of Licensed Massage Therapist or Massage Therapist is EUR 20.00 gross per hour.

Willingness to pay above the minimum rate depending on qualifications and experience.

What we offer

• A positive and supportive working environment
• Flexible working arrangements, either full-time or part-time (Free time in the mornings, work shifts in the afternoons)
• Discounted ski pass for the entire Arlberg region
• Competitive salary above the collective agreement rate
• Additional pay for work on Sundays and public holidays
• Free accommodation provided by the employer
